resources.string: A week that was not counted has no bar: it is not a week without work.

The bars are the hours worked, one for each counted week. The line is the figure named under the chart for the same week, against your own average, the mean of the weeks that have a point: above the middle line when it was higher, below when it was lower. They show what was recorded in the same weeks, not what caused what.

plurals.name: work_charts_line_rule
plurals.item: A week’s point needs %1$d day with a reading; a week with fewer leaves a gap in the line, never a zero.
